outcomes.name: Understanding of the readiness and planning approach has been assessed across all live sites/teams
The readiness and planning approach is consistently applied everywhere the change has gone live

actions.action: Recognise that Planning & Risk is inconsistent across teams/sites since go-live and gather evidence of where the gaps are in the readiness and planning approach.
Identify why the readiness and planning approach hasn't landed consistently for Planning & Risk in specific teams/sites and agree a plan to address it.
Re-engage leaders in lagging teams/sites to re-establish the readiness and planning approach for Planning & Risk.
Confirm the readiness and planning approach for Planning & Risk is being applied consistently across previously inconsistent areas.
Monitor Planning & Risk regularly to ensure the readiness and planning approach stays consistently reinforced everywhere.
Survey teams/sites to understand how Strategic Direction & Leadership has been affected by inconsistent readiness and planning approach since go-live.
Develop a targeted plan to address the specific Strategic Direction & Leadership-related gaps identified in lagging areas.
Deliver targeted support to strengthen Strategic Direction & Leadership in teams/sites where the readiness and planning approach is weakest.
Confirm Strategic Direction & Leadership has improved in previously lagging teams/sites.
Embed regular pulse-checks on Strategic Direction & Leadership so gaps in the readiness and planning approach are caught early in future.
